preconditions.description: The number of test cases T is between 1 and 250, inclusive.
The length of string S is between 1 and 60, inclusive.
The length of string P is between 1 and 60, inclusive.

preconditions.expression: S and P consist of characters 'a'-'z' and 'A'-'Z'
preconditions.description: Both S and P consist of only alphabetic characters.

postconditions.description: The output is either 'Possible' or 'Impossible', indicating whether P can be formed from S using the described rules.
